title: DCSS 2nd Grade ELA Pacing Calendar
scope: Excerpts only: lesson-content lines ClassThread items cite. No names, rosters, small-group links or student information.
content:
[Jan 4–8, week header] Jan 4–8  │  Unit 3: Plants and Animals in the Desert  │  Module 4, Sessions 26–30 (4-Day Student Week)  │  Heggerty Week 16
[Jan 4–8, I Can] I can demonstrate mastery of Unit 3 spelling patterns (long vowels, silent letters, and r-controlled vowel ar).
[Jan 4–8, Tuesday 5 (Session 26), Phonics row] No Foundational Skills (Administer Assessments)
[Jan 4–8, Wednesday 6 (Session 27), Phonics row] Review Sessions 1-10 (Long i, e, o)
[Jan 4–8, Thursday 7 (Session 28), Phonics row] Review Sessions 11-15 (Long u)
[Jan 4–8, Friday 8 (Sessions 29 & 30), Phonics row] Review Sessions 16-25 (Silent Letters & ar)
[Nov 9–13, Phonics] Introduce Long i (y, igh); Practice Long i (y, igh) & Long e (e, ee, y); Introduce Long i (i, ie); Practice Long i & Long e Spelling Patterns; Foundational Skills Week 1 Assessment
[Nov 16–20, Phonics] Introduce Long o (o, oa); Practice Long o (o, oa) & Long i (y, igh); Introduce Long o (ow, oe); Practice Long o Spelling Patterns; Foundational Skills Week 2 Assessment
[Nov 16–20, week header] Nov 16–20  │  Unit 3: Plants and Animals in the Desert  │  Module 1, Sessions 6–10  │  Heggerty Week 13
[Nov 30–Dec 4, week header] Nov 30-Dec 4  │  Unit 3: Plants and Animals in the Desert  │  Module 2, Sessions 11–15  │  Heggerty Week 14
[Nov 30–Dec 4, Phonics] Introduce Long u (u_e, ue); Practice Long u (u_e, ue) & Long o (o, oa); Introduce Long u (ew, u); Practice Long u Spelling Patterns; Foundational Skills Week 3 Assessment
[Dec 7–11, Phonics] Introduce Silent Letters (wr, kn); Practice Silent Letters (wr, kn) & Long u (u_e, ue); Introduce Silent Letters (gn, mb, sc); Practice Silent Letters (gn, mb, sc); Foundational Skills Week 4 Assessment
